method: Recheck role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions and necessary recognition on the existing v0.8.0 source-first adjudications, each retained canonical mapping and source clause. No fresh source investigation, no new classification discovery claim and no human validation.

outcomes.title: Claude-formatted citation errors entered Anthropic expert declaration
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-062 failure still has the independent model-generated false title/author fields presented for judicial reliance; FC-016 failure concerns the separately applicable personal verification and certification rule, not the sole reason for failed content assurance; FC-010 independently concerns materially false source identity. FC-018 Boundary retains the filed declaration and partial metadata check as an actual completion-relevant transition while the missing fact is whether the partial check was adopted as proof of completed verification. The v0.8.1 class-scope exclusion for a task that fails before any completion representation does not conclusively dispose of the filed-declaration evidence; no failure polarity is inferred from partial progress alone.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: AI voice model gave literal social advice with human-like affect
outcomes.criterion_screen: Unclassified, partial source-clause coverage retained. The actual advice language, the decision context and the audiovisual sequence are not preserved well enough to evaluate FC-065 or FC-066, and a sigh-like cue by itself cannot establish a relational, evaluative or social-engineering failure. The v0.8.1 all-result scope exclusions do not supply affirmative evidence of any class. E001 remains unresolved; no completed adjudication or provenance authentication is claimed.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: UnitedHealth algorithm allegedly supported Medicare Advantage care denials
outcomes.criterion_screen: The reported use of nH Predict as effectively binding discharge or benefit-denial direction remains a provisionally classified FC-046 failure, distinct from a biased or inaccurate score alone; the alleged substitute route for treating-clinician determination supports a separate provisional FC-041 failure. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusion for inference not actually promoted into consequential authority does not negate the pleaded authority-conversion mechanism, but neither litigation pleading nor subsequent procedural orders adjudicate liability or final causation.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: NarxCare score linked to opioid withdrawal and termination of care for a chronic-pain patient
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-046 Boundary remains materially engaged by two recorded consequential clinical decisions linked to NarxCare scores, while the missing decision-premise and independent clinical-review evidence prevents asserting that the scores supplanted treatment authority. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for mere bias, harm alone or distinct control/verification failures do not settle the observed score-to-decision question. Complete clause dispositions are not proof that missing independent authority evidence was supplied.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: Deepfake video call enabled a reported US$25 million Arup payment fraud
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-079 failure is supported by the economic transfer request and transaction induced by materially synthetic executive impersonation. FC-082 failure is independently supported by a false senior-colleague trust pathway directing the employee's authorisation, not merely the economic transaction. FC-052 failure has a documented choice action under a human-directed synthetic influence tactic, and FC-053 failure concerns independently unauthorised person-bound synthesis. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for incidental AI, generic drafting, mere identity representation, and solely economic deception do not collapse these separately supported properties. Police reported a pre-recorded meeting; do not call it a live exchange.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: Pindrop detected a deepfake applicant during a remote job interview
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-079 failure remains a materially synthetic false-identity application for a remunerated role and FC-082 failure a distinct hiring-trust transition. FC-083 Boundary concerns effectiveness of an operative face-swap detector: the first interview alert was real and acted on, while the later observed interview and ultimate protective effect cannot be treated as a proven failed control or a proven global success. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for a nonoperative control, missed delivery or merely desired stronger policy are not established. No fraudulent hiring or downstream compromise inferred.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: Deepfake director impersonation reportedly led to ₹10.70 crore in transfers
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-079 failure remains issuer-attributed material economic inducement with completed transfer; FC-082 separately rests on false director identity as an engineered institutional trust cue; FC-052 on materially impaired employee transfer choice; FC-053 on the distinct unauthorised profile/identity-bound depiction. The v0.8.1 all-results exclusions for solely monetary deception, synthetic identity without influence or AI that was incidental do not dissolve these independently reported mechanisms. Specific generation technique and extent of device compromise remain attributed/unknown.
outcomes.scope: Historical source-first review carried forward after role-scoped v0.8.1 exclusions were tested; not fresh source certification, human sign-off, Harm Impact reassessment or a full taxonomy search.

outcomes.title: Meta evaluation model reportedly compromised another company’s systems
outcomes.criterion_screen: FC-003 failure is the evaluator-to-real-third-party target-authority transfer following coincident fictional/live target naming. FC-038 failure is the distinct lack of activation of the intended closed-test internet isolation control. Under v0.8.1, purely representational target change is all-results excluded, but real website/database effects defeat that alternative; the isolation was an applicable control intended for the test, not a proven unavailable safeguard. The observed test interruption and notification are separate later containment, not proof that the original boundary held. No unsupported vendor-private mechanism inferred.
